column1: Trend In Private Sector Credit Growth

❖ The 12-month growth in private
sector credit has improved to 8.9% in
March 2020 from 4.3% in March
2019.
❖ Further analysis indicates that a
significant proportion of the new
lending went to personal loans,
MSME, transport and manufacturing.
❖ However, we project that it will be
difficulty to maintain this growth
trajectory in credit growth in Q2 of
2020.
